value: Summon the Dark Heart, which pulses for <c val="bfd4fd" hlt-name="#TooltipNumbers">50</c><c val="a7a7a7" hlt-name="#ColorGray">~~0.04~~</c> damage per second to nearby enemies and lasts <c val="bfd4fd" hlt-name="#TooltipNumbers">8</c> seconds.<n/><n/>The Dark Heart moves to Shadow Mark's impact location.<n/><n/>The Dark Heart will pursue targets afflicted by Shadow Mark and detonate on impact, dealing <c val="bfd4fd" hlt-name="#TooltipNumbers">305</c><c val="a7a7a7" hlt-name="#ColorGray">~~0.04~~</c> damage to nearby enemies and <c val="bfd4fd" hlt-name="#TooltipNumbers">152</c><c val="a7a7a7" hlt-name="#ColorGray">~~0.04~~</c> more damage to the Marked target.

Shoot a Void Orb that deals <c val="bfd4fd" hlt-name="#TooltipNumbers">75</c><c val="a7a7a7" hlt-name="#ColorGray">~~0.04~~</c> damage to enemies hit, and an additional <c val="bfd4fd" hlt-name="#TooltipNumbers">150</c><c val="a7a7a7" hlt-name="#ColorGray">~~0.04~~</c> damage to enemies in the center.<n/><n/>If an enemy Hero or Structure is hit by the center, they are marked for <c val="bfd4fd" hlt-name="#TooltipNumbers">4</c> seconds.<n/><n/>Targets afflicted by Shadow Mark are Revealed and draw the Dark Heart and Void Minions towards them.

After channeling for <c val="bfd4fd" hlt-name="#TooltipNumbers">2</c> seconds, summon a Void Portal that spawns up to <c val="bfd4fd" hlt-name="#TooltipNumbers">3</c> Void Minions to attack nearby enemies.<n/><n/>You can have up to <c val="bfd4fd" hlt-name="#TooltipNumbers">1</c> active Void Portal.<n/><n/>Enemies near the Void Portal are Slowed by <c val="bfd4fd" hlt-name="#TooltipNumbers">25%</c>.<n/><n/>Void Minions are attracted to targets afflicted by Shadow Mark.<n/><n/><s val="a7a7a7" hlt-name="TooltipSubscript">The Portal expires after 12 seconds.</s><n/><s val="a7a7a7" hlt-name="TooltipSubscript">Void Minions automatically choose a nearby lane to push.</s><n/><s val="a7a7a7" hlt-name="TooltipSubscript">Void Minion Basic Attacks deal 50</s><c val="a7a7a7" hlt-name="#ColorGray">~~0.04~~</c><s val="a7a7a7" hlt-name="TooltipSubscript"> damage per hit.</s><n/><s val="a7a7a7" hlt-name="TooltipSubscript">Void Minions lose Health over 12 seconds.</s>

Cast to teleport Xal'atath <c val="bfd4fd" hlt-name="#TooltipNumbers">3</c> times in a triangular pattern.<n/><n/>Each time Xal'atath teleports, her Basic Attacks deal <s val="bfd4fd" hlt-name="StandardTooltipDetails">10%</s> more damage while the Ability is active.<n/><n/>Reactivate to end Void Step early and remain at your current location.<n/><n/><s val="a7a7a7" hlt-name="TooltipSubscript">Weapon Bonus Damage caps at +30%.</s>

After attacking enemies with her Basic Attacks 5 times, Xal'atath can activate Void Volley to unleash a barrage of 6 Void Orbs at a target location, each dealing 90~~0.04~~ damage on impact.Charge fully decays if Xal’atath does not hit an enemy with a Basic Attack after 6 seconds.Quest: Hit enemy Heroes with Void Volley to grant 1 stack per hit and increases Void Volley's damage by 1%. Lose all stacks upon dying.Reward (20 Stacks): +2 Void Volley Range Stack loss on death lowered to 6.Reward (60 Stacks): -1 Basic Attack required to charge Void Volley.Mythic Reward (100 Stacks): +50% Basic Attack and Void Volley Damage. Void Volley projectiles Pierce all targets.Stack loss will never cause the Hero to fall below a quest reward threshold.

Void Eruption splits into <c val="bfd4fd" hlt-name="#TooltipNumbers">3</c> orbiting Void Orbs. Each enemy Hero hit by their explosions reduces Void Eruption's cooldown by <c val="bfd4fd" hlt-name="#TooltipNumbers">14</c> seconds.
While Void Step is active, Xal'atath's Basic Attack Speed is increased by <c val="bfd4fd" hlt-name="#TooltipNumbers">150%</c>.

Activating Void Step summons a seal of void magic on the ground. When the seal completes, it deals <c val="bfd4fd" hlt-name="#TooltipNumbers">250</c><c val="a7a7a7" hlt-name="#ColorGray">~~0.04~~</c> damage to enemies inside and Silences them for <s val="bfd4fd" hlt-name="StandardTooltipDetails">2</s> seconds.
